Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional

import requests


class FederatedProfileError(Exception):
    pass


AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]
AUTH0_MGMT_API_TOKEN = os.environ["AUTH0_MGMT_API_TOKEN"]
AUTH0_AUDIENCE = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/"
AUTH0_USERINFO_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/userinfo"
AUTH0_MGMT_USERS_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/api/v2/users"


def _coalesce(*values: Any) -> Optional[Any]:
    for value in values:
        if value not in (None, "", [], {}):
            return value
    return None


def _to_list(value: Any) -> List[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    return [value]


def _auth0_connection(provider: Optional[str], identities: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[str]:
    if provider:
        return provider
    for identity in identities:
        candidate = identity.get("provider") or identity.get("connection")
        if candidate:
            return str(candidate)
    return None


def normalize_federated_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    identities = _to_list(claims.get("identities"))
    provider = _auth0_connection(claims.get("provider"), identities)
    user_id = claims.get("sub") or claims.get("user_id")

    emails: List[str] = []
    primary_email = claims.get("email")
    if primary_email:
        emails.append(primary_email)

    for key in ("upn", "preferred_username", "unique_name"):
        value = claims.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, str) and "@" in value and value not in emails:
            emails.append(value)

    groups = _to_list(
        _coalesce(
            claims.get("groups"),
            claims.get("roles"),
            claims.get("https://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role"),
        )
    )

    picture = _coalesce(
        claims.get("picture"),
        claims.get("avatar_url"),
        claims.get("photo"),
        claims.get("https://graph.microsoft.com/photo"),
    )

    given_name = _coalesce(
        claims.get("given_name"),
        claims.get("first_name"),
        claims.get("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/givenname"),
    )
    family_name = _coalesce(
        claims.get("family_name"),
        claims.get("last_name"),
        claims.get("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/surname"),
    )
    full_name = _coalesce(
        claims.get("name"),
        " ".join([p for p in [given_name, family_name] if p]).strip() or None,
        claims.get("nickname"),
    )

    normalized = {
        "provider": provider,
        "subject": user_id,
        "email": primary_email,
        "emails": emails,
        "email_verified": bool(claims.get("email_verified", False)),
        "name": full_name,
        "given_name": given_name,
        "family_name": family_name,
        "nickname": claims.get("nickname"),
        "username": _coalesce(claims.get("preferred_username"), claims.get("username"), claims.get("nickname")),
        "picture": picture,
        "locale": claims.get("locale"),
        "zoneinfo": claims.get("zoneinfo"),
        "updated_at": claims.get("updated_at"),
        "groups": [str(g) for g in groups if g not in (None, "")],
        "org_id": claims.get("org_id"),
        "tenant": _coalesce(
            claims.get("tenant"),
            claims.get("tid"),
            claims.get("https://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/tenantid"),
        ),
        "raw": claims,
    }
    return normalized


def fetch_federated_user_profile(
    *,
    access_token: Optional[str] = None,
    auth0_user_id: Optional[str] = None,
    include_management_record: bool = True,
    timeout: int = 15,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not access_token and not auth0_user_id:
        raise ValueError("Provide either access_token or auth0_user_id.")

    aggregated_claims: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    management_user: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

    if access_token:
        userinfo_resp = requests.get(
            AUTH0_USERINFO_URL,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        if userinfo_resp.status_code != 200:
            raise FederatedProfileError(
                f"Auth0 /userinfo failed: {userinfo_resp.status_code} {userinfo_resp.text}"
            )
        aggregated_claims.update(userinfo_resp.json())

    resolved_user_id = auth0_user_id or aggregated_claims.get("sub")
    if include_management_record and resolved_user_id:
        mgmt_resp = requests.get(
            f"{AUTH0_MGMT_USERS_URL}/{requests.utils.quote(resolved_user_id, safe='')}",
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {AUTH0_MGMT_API_TOKEN}",
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            params={
                "fields": ",".join(
                    [
                        "user_id",
                        "email",
                        "email_verified",
                        "name",
                        "given_name",
                        "family_name",
                        "nickname",
                        "picture",
                        "identities",
                        "user_metadata",
                        "app_metadata",
                        "username",
                        "locale",
                        "updated_at",
                    ]
                ),
                "include_fields": "true",
            },
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        if mgmt_resp.status_code != 200:
            raise FederatedProfileError(
                f"Auth0 Management API get user failed: {mgmt_resp.status_code} {mgmt_resp.text}"
            )
        management_user = mgmt_resp.json()
        merged = dict(management_user)
        merged.update(aggregated_claims)
        aggregated_claims = merged

    normalized = normalize_federated_claims(aggregated_claims)
    normalized["auth0"] = {
        "domain": AUTH0_DOMAIN,
        "audience": AUTH0_AUDIENCE,
        "user_id": resolved_user_id or normalized.get("subject"),
        "management_user": management_user,
    }
    return normalized
